builder_error_same_element: Pick two different elements for the cation and the anion.
builder_subtitle: Pick a cation (positive charge) and an anion (negative charge). The formula is the simplest integer ratio that balances the charges.
home_search_placeholder: Search by name, symbol, or atomic number…
home_select_prompt: Select an element to see its details.
home_subtitle: Click an element for details · search by name, symbol, or atomic number · switch trend view above the table.
landing_feature_i18n_desc: Seven languages, switchable from the top-right selector — your choice persists across sessions.
landing_feature_table_desc: Click any element to see its full data. Search by name, symbol, or atomic number. Recolor the table by ionization, radius, electronegativity, and more.
landing_feature_theme_desc: Toggle dark and light themes from the header. The choice persists between sessions.
landing_feature_tools_desc: Molar mass, balanced equations, ionic compound builder, and a solubility lookup table — same domain logic as the desktop app.
landing_hero_subtitle: Browse all 118 elements in the browser, or download the desktop app for an offline, faster experience.
landing_mobile_note: The desktop app does not target mobile — use the in-browser version above. The web build is responsive on phones and tablets.
lewis_extended_octet_note: Extended octet — see electron configuration for d/f shells.
lewis_not_applicable: Lewis dot diagram is not conventionally drawn for this element.
molar_subtitle: Enter a chemical formula. Hydrate notation works (e.g. CuSO4·5H2O or CuSO4.5H2O).
solubility_subtitle: Solubility verdict for every cation × anion pair, generated from a small priority-ordered rule set.
stoich_subtitle: Enter a chemical equation. Use '->' (or '=' / '→') to separate reactants and products.
tools_subtitle: Calculators and lookups built on the same domain logic as the desktop app.
